caption: The drawing depicts a standing human figure positioned on a small rectangular base. The figure is shown in profile, facing left, and has dark brown skin. It is dressed in a beige knee-length tunic with brown leggings and brown moccasin-like footwear. A long, flowing red cloak with golden-yellow trim covers the shoulders and most of the body, extending down to the calves. The figure wears a headdress consisting of a beige cloth and a curved, brown horn or feather protruding backward. Across the back is a dark quiver filled with yellow and red arrows. The figure's right hand holds a tall, dark staff or club that reaches chest height. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, providing contrast to the colors and details of the central figure.
title: Cigar Store Indian
